import asyncio
import time
from unittest import mock
import daphne.server as srvmod
from daphne.server import Server
loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
done = loop.create_future()
done.set_result(None)
stuck = loop.create_future()
srv = Server.__new__(Server)
srv.application_close_timeout = 10
srv.connections = {
    'p_done': {'application_instance': done, 'disconnected': time.time()},
    'p_stuck': {'application_instance': stuck, 'disconnected': time.time() - 100},
}
with mock.patch.object(srvmod.reactor, 'callLater') as cl:
    srv.application_checker()
    assert cl.called
print('conns', {k: sorted(v) for k, v in srv.connections.items()})
assert stuck.cancelled(), 'stuck app past close timeout must be cancelled'
assert srv.connections == {}, 'reaped and cancelled connections must be fully released'
print('app_checker_ok')
